provenance.source: Supplemental Experimental Procedures pp. 7–9, Apparatus and Stimuli, Design and Procedure, and Data Analysis and Sigmoid Fitting.
Current Biology version of record pp. 407–409 and Supplemental Experimental Procedures pp. 7 and 9–11. The shared Experiment 2 assessment and alternate Experiment 3 timings are documented separately.

The toolkit uses a generated continuous pink-noise source and a virtual path with nominal endpoints about 105 and 5 cm to define a three-second preview. These are renderer settings only. The deterministic seed and evenly balanced cell allocation within blocks are toolkit defaults. The two social-condition blocks are kept together and condition order is counterbalanced.

notes: This manifest audits recreation inside the PPS Toolkit GUI. It distinguishes toolkit-generated recreations of reported parameters from the original authors' exact stimulus set.
